items.item: Every field has a visible label above it; no placeholder is used as the label
items.evidence: All general-info fields use <label for=... class="block ... mb-1"> above the control (customer, invNo, series, issueDate, terms, dueDate, method, note). Placeholders only hold examples (textarea 'Ví dụ: Giao hàng...', price '0'). Table cells rely on column headers plus aria-label.

items.item: Field widths match the expected input (dates and quantities are narrow)
items.evidence: Quantity column is w-24, discount input w-16, tax select w-28; dates and short selects sit in md:col-span-3 quarter-width cells rather than full row. Dates (~263px) are wider than needed but not full-width.

items.item: Required fields are marked with an asterisk
items.evidence: * on Khách hàng, Ngày hóa đơn, Hạn thanh toán. Line-item product/qty are not starred but are covered by the 'at least one valid line' check.

items.item: Line items can be added and removed; quantities, prices and amounts are right-aligned with tabular figures
items.evidence: addRow()/#addRow/#addRowTop and [data-del] handler (resets to one blank row when last is deleted). Qty/price inputs 'text-right num', amount td 'text-right num', headers text-right. Audit nonTabular 0; only the # index column flagged misaligned.

items.item: Subtotal, tax and total are computed and right-aligned with locale currency formatting
items.evidence: calc()/totals() fill #tSub, #tTax, #tTotal via Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN') + ' ₫' (e.g. 181.742.400 ₫); dd values pinned right with flex justify-between and class num; also per-rate tax lines.

items.item: Fields validate on blur and on submit; with three or more errors a summary appears and focus moves to the first error
items.evidence: validate() runs only from save(false); no blur/focusout listeners on fields (only 'change' on customer clears its error). No error summary element, no focus() call; save() just toasts and window.scrollTo top.

items.item: Save is not disabled before submitting; it is disabled only while the submission is in progress
items.evidence: #save is never disabled and there is no in-progress state; save() is synchronous with a toast, so double-clicks resubmit and the disabled-during-submit behaviour is not implemented.

items.item: Save and Cancel stay reachable in a sticky bar, and leaving with unsaved changes asks for confirmation
items.evidence: Sticky bar passes: 'fixed bottom-0 ... z-20' containing #cancel, #saveDraft, #save. But no dirty-state tracking and no beforeunload; #cancel always calls confirm('Hủy hóa đơn đang soạn?...') then reloads, even with no changes, and navigating away or breadcrumb links do not prompt.

notes: Audit score 66: text-contrast x7 (sidebar footer 3.75:1, index column 2.56:1, subtitle 4.34:1), table rows 72.5px (too tall for 32-48px), # column not right-aligned, 4 card shadows (shadow-sm). Tells: dark slate-900 sidebar with indigo-500 logo tile and indigo primary; table header uses 'uppercase tracking-wide'. Avatar 'TH' matches the named person so not flagged; amber draft pill is single status, not rainbow. No gradients, glass, emoji, hover-lift or oversized radius. Form-behaviour gaps (validation, summary, focus, submit state, dirty tracking) are the main failures.
